questions.q: What does the summary say mindsight is the skill of?
a: Reflecting on the link between your body and mind
questions.why: The overview defines it as reflecting on the connection between body and mind, blending awareness and self-knowledge.

questions.q: How does the summary suggest you picture yourself to stay balanced?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a river embraces obstacles, makes room for them and keeps to its course.

questions.q: What does the summary say about your emotions?
a: They are passing experiences, not character traits
They are fixed patterns from childhood
questions.why: Lesson 2 says seeing emotions as fleeting gives you more control over them.

questions.q: What are the three pillars of mindsight?
questions.why: Lesson 2 lists noticing distractions, watching thoughts without judgment, and accepting emotions.

questions.q: What does the summary recommend when a conversation gets too heated?
a: Take a time out and return with a fresh attitude
Keep arguing until the issue is settled
questions.why: Lesson 3 suggests a pause, some calming practice, and then a return to the conversation.
